---
title: "Publish the demo and the manual"
subtitle: "SOP SYS-06 · Technical systems manual"
---

## Purpose

Publish the online demo of the app and this manual to the web, and preview
the manual on this computer while editing it.

## Applies to

The person responsible for the shop's systems, and anyone who edits the
manual.

## Before you begin

- GitHub Pages is switched on for the project. This is set once: on GitHub,
  **Settings** → **Pages** → **Build and deployment** → **Source**: **GitHub
  Actions**.

## Where they are published

| What | Address |
|---|---|
| The online demo | <https://jasonrwilliams-maker.github.io/dog-groomer-platform/> |
| This manual | <https://jasonrwilliams-maker.github.io/dog-groomer-platform/sop/> |

The demo runs the real database in the visitor's browser, with made-up dogs.
It has no Admin, no photos and no AI. Nothing a visitor does is saved.

## Procedure

### Publish

1. Merge the pull request into `master` on GitHub. See [SYS-05 Read the
   automatic checks on GitHub](github-checks.qmd) first.

   Publishing starts by itself. GitHub builds the demo and the manual
   together and puts them up, usually within two minutes.

2. To watch it, click the **Actions** tab on GitHub and click the newest run
   named **browser demo**. A green check mark means it is published.
3. Open the addresses above and reload the page. The changes show.

### Preview the manual while editing

4. Open a new terminal in the `dog-groomer-platform` folder.
5. Type these commands, pressing Enter after each:

   ```bash
   cd sop
   ```

   ```bash
   quarto preview
   ```

   The manual opens in the browser and reloads each time a page is saved.
   Keep the terminal open while editing. To stop, click in the terminal and
   press **Ctrl+C**.

### Retake the screenshots

6. When the app's screens change, retake every picture in the manual with
   one command. The instructions are in `sop/screenshots/README.md`.

## Result

The demo and the manual at the addresses above show the latest merged
version.

## If something goes wrong

### The term 'quarto' is not recognized

The terminal was opened before Quarto was installed, or Quarto is not
installed. Close the terminal and open a new one. If it still fails, install
Quarto from [quarto.org](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/).

### The browser demo run failed

Click the run on the **Actions** tab and read the step with the red ✕. The
published site stays as it was until a run succeeds.
